biggest_catch: The 'up to $1,000' headline needs a $100,000 net deposit with average assets held for 180 days. An ordinary $500 deposit earns $30 of NVDA fractional stock, locked behind a 60-day asset-maintenance requirement, and the deposit must settle by October 15, 2026. ACH/wire/instant transfers only — ACAT transfers from another broker do not count toward the deposit bonus.
catches: After receiving the free stocks you must maintain average assets at the tier level for 60 days (120 days for the $50k tier's extra $200; 180 days for the $100k tier's final $400) — withdrawing below the threshold during the freeze can forfeit the reward.
Only deposits via ACH, wire, or instant transfer qualify; cash/securities moved via ACATS or FOP are NOT eligible for this deposit bonus.
The Promotion Period is September 1, 2026 – October 15, 2026 (or 14 days before Anthropic's first trading day, whichever is earlier) — deposits must settle in time.
Fractional NVDA shares are illiquid outside Moomoo and cannot be transferred; the stock's value fluctuates with the market.
The 8.1% APY booster applies only to the first $20,000 in Cash Sweep for 60 days, requires manual activation in the app, and the base rate is subject to change.
$100 trading coupons (10 × $10) are usable only on single buy-to-open orders over $100 and expire 180 days from issuance.

steps: Open a new Moomoo brokerage account (eligible if you have not opened one before January 1, 2026, or opened one but never deposited).

Complete a net deposit via ACH, wire, or instant transfer that settles before October 15, 2026, 23:59 ET — ACAT transfers do not count for this bonus. A $100 net deposit also earns $100 in Trading Coupons (10 × $10).
Hit the tier you can afford: $500+ earns $30 in NVDA fractional shares; $2,000+ earns $100 total; $10,000+ earns $200 total; $50,000+ earns $400 total; $100,000+ earns $1,000 total.

Maintain the required average assets for the hold period (60 days for tiers up to $10,000; 120 days for the $50,000 tier's extra portion; 180 days for the $100,000 tier's final portion) — do not let the balance fall below the tier threshold during the freeze.
The free NVDA stocks are added to your account and available for trading within 5 trading days after the waiting period ends.
timing: Free stocks added to the account within 5 trading days following the conclusion of the waiting period; assets must be maintained 60 days ($500–$10,000 tiers), 120 days ($50,000 tier extra), or 180 days ($100,000 tier final portion).
